document: D023 conformance vectors for acceptance T36-T40, plus V32 and SCHEMA spec-time cases that are not T36-T40 acceptance
nature: Documentation vectors only. Every case states explicit input facts and the single expected outcome required by the contract. No case asserts that a runtime test ran, passed, or produced these values. Nothing here is produced by executing prepare, execute, assess, or any test runner.
scope: D023-1 through D023-5 mapped onto T36-T40 of acceptance-criteria.md; V32-N1/V32-N2/V32-N3 and SCHEMA-N1 are spec-time or schema-layer negatives and are not T36-T40 acceptance

digest_examples.notice: All 64-hex values below are syntactically valid FIXED EXAMPLE strings used to make the vectors concrete. They are not computed digests of any bytes. The coordinator will hash-verify real artifacts later; no vector here claims a computed relationship between two digests unless it is stated as an equality of field values.

semantic_ids.notice: Semantic ids reuse the fixed example digests above purely for shape. They are not claimed to be the result of applying projection P to any payload.

input_facts.authorized_prefix: archives/p0a-demo (explicitly configured non-fixture prefix, distinct from any registered fixture prefix)

expected_outcome.reported_fact: semantic required closure incomplete: role samples has no readable resource entry

invariants: B lists the semantic required closure and reports the missing role
Apps does not substitute an in-memory id for a missing resource
no PreparedRef is published before final prepared canonical bytes are verified and archived
prohibited_inferences: an in-memory prepared_id may stand in for a committed PreparedRef
a partial archive with some roles present counts as success

input_facts.protocol_bytes_source: frozen protocol canonical bytes delivered in process by B
input_facts.resource_reader: read-only per-role reader opened over the resource closure
input_facts.final_bytes_verified_by: B pure encode/validate_prepared accepting the allocated location

invariants: the prepared bytes read back in a fresh process are byte-identical to the archived canonical bytes
the identity recomputed in the fresh process equals the published prepared_id
B did not write to disk and did not depend on Apps storage routing
prohibited_inferences: a successful archive in this vector proves that any internal field or location change keeps prepared_id
a different digest value in this file is proof of a computed hash relationship

input_facts.prepared_internal_field_change: a resource description object inside PreparedEvaluation.resources changes one internal field value
input_facts.outer_location_change: only ArtifactRef.location of an externally declared Ref changes

expected_outcome.internal_field_change: the affected sha256 and prepared_id are recomputed under the existing identity rules
expected_outcome.outer_location_change: stripped by projection P only where the field is declared ArtifactRef, so prepared_id is unchanged for that case

invariants: committed bytes are never rewritten in place
a distinct canonical byte change yields a distinct identity
prohibited_inferences: any relocation of any internal location preserves prepared_id

invariants: the expected value is copied unchanged from the frozen prepared.recipe
H computes the actual entrypoint digest before the candidate process starts and does not import B
prohibited_inferences: a matching code digest implies the candidate is correct or that any claim PASSes

expected_outcome.commit_failure_case: a failure to commit this record raises the existing ExecutionPersistenceError and yields no valid new RecordRef

invariants: matching entrypoint name and revision do not substitute for a matching code digest
zero candidate processes start before the comparison succeeds
prohibited_inferences: a not_started record is a claim FAIL
an unresolvable entrypoint may be reported as a mismatch

input_facts.actual_entrypoint_bytes: unresolvable under the supported entrypoint/package scope

invariants: RuntimeBinding.code_sha256 stays null when actual bytes could not be resolved
the expected value is never copied into the observed field
prohibited_inferences: unknown actual identity is equivalent to a proven mismatch

expected_outcome.failure: semantic check V05/V32 rejects non-null expected_code_sha256 in ordinary command mode; this is a spec-time InvalidExecutionSpec, with no start and no record

invariants: ordinary command mode requires expected_code_sha256 to be null
this is a spec-time InvalidExecutionSpec: no start and no record
prohibited_inferences: a schema-valid digest string is acceptable in ordinary command mode
this ordinary-command violation is a T37 actual-entrypoint mismatch

expected_outcome.failure: semantic check V32 rejects null expected_code_sha256 in evaluation mode; recipe.code_sha256 is a required non-null Sha256; this is a spec-time InvalidExecutionSpec, with no start and no record

invariants: evaluation mode requires a non-null expected value equal to the frozen required recipe.code_sha256
this is a spec-time InvalidExecutionSpec: no start and no record
prohibited_inferences: null opts out of the pre-start comparison
a null expected in evaluation mode is a T37 actual-entrypoint mismatch

expected_outcome.failure: semantic check V32 rejects evaluation-mode expected_code_sha256 that is non-null but not equal to the frozen required recipe.code_sha256; this is a spec-time InvalidExecutionSpec, with no start and no record

invariants: evaluation mode requires a non-null expected value equal to the frozen required recipe.code_sha256
this is a spec-time InvalidExecutionSpec: no start and no record
T37 applies only after expected already equals the frozen recipe, then the actual entrypoint digest is checked
prohibited_inferences: a non-null expected that differs from recipe.code_sha256 is a T37 actual-entrypoint mismatch
a valid Sha256 string opts out of equality with the frozen recipe

input_facts.command_step_object: valid in every other required field
input_facts.expected_code_sha256_value: not applicable: the key is omitted entirely

expected_outcome.failure: schema rejects the object because expected_code_sha256 is required even when its value is null; a schema validator failure is not a runtime PublicError and must not be classified as InvalidExecutionSpec

invariants: the field is required; nullability is expressed by an explicit null value, not by omission
a schema-layer rejection is not a runtime PublicError and is not InvalidExecutionSpec
prohibited_inferences: omitting the field is equivalent to a null value
a schema validator failure is a runtime InvalidExecutionSpec or other PublicError

invariants: ContextProvider.collect never returns a valid ArtifactRef for bytes that were not committed
the draft's proposed location and digest are not a delivery record
prohibited_inferences: a draft's proposed digest may be published as a delivered ArtifactRef

input_facts.retention_by_H: succeeded through H's own capture/commit route

invariants: the sealed DeliveredContext.artifact points only at retained bytes
the bytes read in a fresh process equal the draft's actual delivered bytes
Apps did not write to the H RunStore
prohibited_inferences: the draft is a serialized JSON DTO or a JSON stream with a schema shape
a ref-only success without readable bytes is acceptable

expected_outcome.failure: the committed-delivery contract is violated; a reference alone that resolves to ArtifactUnavailable is not a valid delivery

invariants: a sealed delivery must remain readable from a new process under the same configuration
prohibited_inferences: publication of an ArtifactRef alone satisfies D023-3

invariants: the claim key is checked against the frozen protocol before the assessor is called
prohibited_inferences: an unknown key may be treated as a missing-evidence INCONCLUSIVE claim

invariants: Apps does not choose a first claim on the caller's behalf
prohibited_inferences: a single-claim protocol permits omitting the primary key

invariants: a key present in the protocol but absent from the B result is a result-contract error, not a caller mistake
Apps does not synthesize the missing claim verdict
prohibited_inferences: a missing result key becomes InvalidRequest
an omitted key becomes INCONCLUSIVE produced by Apps

invariants: archive failure takes priority over the selected claim verdict
no AssessmentRef is invented from an unsaved in-memory result
prohibited_inferences: an in-memory assessment justifies a published AssessmentRef

invariants: exit 8 reports only the selected claim
other claim and scope results are preserved unchanged
Apps produces no overall verdict
prohibited_inferences: exit 8 means the whole evaluation failed

input_facts.run_store: same persistent RunStore (a new process may open it; same backing store)
input_facts.saved_apps_execute_request: previously saved complete file, attempt already allocated

invariants: replay reuses the original attempt and original request bytes
a completed state returns the original RecordRef without rerunning
prohibited_inferences: a lost response implies a new attempt

input_facts.saved_apps_execute_request: previously saved complete file, attempt already allocated

invariants: an unknown state is never re-executed automatically
the original attempt identity is preserved
prohibited_inferences: recovery_required permits a fresh attempt to finish the work

input_facts.replay_request_change: output_root differs from the saved request
input_facts.replay_attempt: same attempt_id as the saved request

invariants: disconnect replay requires the original request bytes
a different request is not the same replay
prohibited_inferences: a matching attempt_id makes any later request a replay

input_facts.proposed_action: call allocate_attempt again and run with a fresh deadline
input_facts.proposed_label: described by the caller as a resend

expected_outcome.reported_fact: an expired rerun is not a disconnect replay

invariants: replay must reuse the original attempt and original request
deadlines and budgets are not extended by a replay
prohibited_inferences: an expired rerun under a new attempt counts as the same replay

input_facts.apps_execute_request: valid in every other required field

expected_outcome.failure: schema rejects the request because attempt is required

invariants: attempt is mandatory
execute never allocates an attempt itself
StorageConfig is not a member of any Apps*Request
prohibited_inferences: execute may allocate an attempt when the field is missing
StorageConfig may be embedded in a request to avoid host injection

notes: Each acceptance row has at least one negative and one positive vector.
Expected outcomes are contract requirements, not observations. No vector records a runtime pass.
Digest strings are fixed syntactic examples; the coordinator will hash-verify real artifacts separately.
These vectors do not amend the historical archived outputs and do not create a permanent gate exemption.

T37 coverage is only T37-P1, T37-N1, and T37-N2. V32-N1, V32-N2, and V32-N3 are spec-time InvalidExecutionSpec cases (no start, no record) and are not T37 acceptance. SCHEMA-N1 is a schema-layer missing-key rejection; a schema validator must not be equated with a runtime PublicError or InvalidExecutionSpec.
